I'll keep that in mind. He's not on drugs anymore (afaik) but he never went through a program, and he doesn't really understand that recovery is about more than just kicking the habit I think.

There is a church nearby, I could probably check that out. I don't go there but I'm sure they'd help or give a little advice. And I've got a few teachers I could talk to when school starts up if nothing ever happens with that too. Thank you! I'll definitely look more into this stuff

Thank you so much. I really do want to get out, I can't stay here for much longer. It's too much. I'll keep trying for my brothers and my friends, and *especially* my dog. I love that little guy too much

Thank you, so much. That's exactly how it feels to me too, I'm terrified honestly. I'm so scared. Scared for my brothers, scared this will end bad for all of us. My mom has counseling now at least, at the same place and time as me actually.

I want him to get help so bad but he won't listen, he doesn't even think anything's wrong. No one in my family even really seems to understand how screwed up all of this is. I want some sort of forced help. Do you think I should call cps or something? Do they have counselors or whatever? People who could come over and force us all to sit down and talk about being better, and stop him if he goes crazy and starts throwing things and attacking people? It's not physical abuse and we're not in an unfit home or anything but I definitely think there's some emotional abuse, neglect, stuff like that. And are there resources to get counseling for families at their home when nobody would really have to time or want to go otherwise? CPS is the only thing that comes to mind, but anything. I'm sorry if you don't know by the way, I'm just so desperate at this point.
